thought: The Slack action (action_1) is missing required parameters for sending a message. According to the Slack action param descriptions, 'select', 'channelId', 'messageType', and 'text' are required. I will set these parameters properly to send the message to channel 'general' with messageType as 'text' and text extracted from input_data's 'text' field using expression.
plan: Set 'select' param to 'channel' to send message to a channel.
Set 'channelId' param with mode 'name' and value 'general' to specify the Slack channel.
Set 'messageType' to 'text' for simple text message.
Set 'text' param to '={{$json["text"]}}' to extract message text from input_data.
Test the Slack action to confirm message is sent successfully.
criticism: Without setting these parameters, the Slack action cannot send messages and results in execution failure. This is a critical fix needed to proceed.
